name: Woody
subtitle: Helping a Friend
rulesText:
\Hang On!\ When you play this character, choose one of the following. If you have another Toy character in play, choose both instead:
• You may return a character card with cost 2 or less from your discard to your hand.
• You may play a character with cost 2 or less for free.
author: Marcel Berg

name: Ming Lee
subtitle: Proud Parent
rulesText:
\Biggest Fan\ If you have a character named Mei Lee in play, you pay 1 {I} less to play this character.

\Follow the Music\ If you played a song this turn, you pay 1 {I} less to play this character.
author: Maria Dresden

name: Isabela Madrigal
subtitle: Kind Cultivator
flavorText: She didn’t just clear the vines from her friends’ path—she turned the tendrils into beautiful scenery.
author: Linh Dang

name: Tyler Nguyen-Baker
subtitle: 4*Town Fan
flavorText: “I can’t believe they’re right there! This is the best day of my life!”
author: Dev Madan / Leonardo Giammichele

name: Rabbit
subtitle: Hunny Paladin
rulesText:
<Bodyguard> (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.) 

\Hunny Aura\ When you play this character, chosen Hunny character gets +1 {L} this turn.
author: Kapik

name: Celia Mae
subtitle: Friendly Receptionist
rulesText: \Please Hold\ When you play this character, you may pay 1 {I} to ready chosen character of yours. They can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.
flavorText: "You'll have to speak up. I can't hear you over my hair."
author: Filipe Laurentino

name: Meilin Lee
subtitle: Lead Vocalist
rulesText:
<Singer> 3 (This character counts as cost 3 to sing songs.)

\Band Loyalty\ This character can't sing songs without <Sing Together>.
author: Denny Minonne

name: Priya Mangal
subtitle: Serious Music Lover
rulesText: \This Is My Jam\ When you play this character, if there's a song card in your discard, gain 1 lore.
flavorText: "I was born to do this."
author: Diego Machuca

name: Miriam Mendelsohn
subtitle: Ticket Holder
rulesText: \I Got 'Em!\ When you play this character, each player draws a card.
flavorText: “Most things are, like, whatever. But my friends are, like, <yeah>!”
author: Diego Machuca

name: Lilo
subtitle: Patient Weaver
rulesText: <Support> (Whenever this character quests, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)
flavorText: "Okay Scrump, now it's time for the finishing touches."
author: Patri Balanovsky

name: Kocoum
subtitle: Defender of the Tribe
rulesText: <Bodyguard> (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
flavorText: “It’s dangerous out there.”
author: Mel Milton

name: Pocahontas
subtitle: Guiding the Tribe
rulesText: \Stay Close\ When you play this character, you may play a character with cost 1 for free.
flavorText: “These vines are far from natural. They must end somewhere."
author: Kendall Hale

name: Woody
subtitle: Town Sheriff
rulesText: \Move Along\ When you play this character, until the start of your next turn, chosen opposing character can't challenge and must quest if able.
flavorText: "This town ain't big enough for the two of us."
author: Omar Lozano

name: Abby Park
subtitle: Over the Top
rulesText: \Rock the Mic\ Once during your turn, whenever you play a song, you may ready this character. If you do, she can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.
flavorText: Putting the "POW" in "power ballad"!
author: Jules Dubost

name: Gaston
subtitle: Superior Archer
rulesText: \Watch This!\ When you play this character, you may banish chosen character with 5 {S} or more.
flavorText: "Is that the best you can do? Let me show you how a <real> marksman does it!"
author: Mané Kandalyan Manderson

name: Meilin Lee
subtitle: Losing Control
rulesText: \Red Panda Power\ When you play this character, look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Red Panda character card or a song card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
author: Malia Ewart

name: 4*Town
subtitle: Hottest Band of the Year
rulesText:
<Singer> 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to sing songs.)

\Star Performance\ Whenever this character sings a song with <Sing Together>, draw a card.
flavorText: "I never met nobody . . . like you."
author: Koni

name: Mike Wazowski
subtitle: Heroic Climber
rulesText: \Find a Friend\ When you play this character and whenever he quests, each player reveals the top card of their deck. If it's a character card, they may put it into their hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of their deck.
author: Eva Widermann

name: Boo
subtitle: In Disguise
rulesText: \You're Safe Now\ While you have an exerted character named Sulley in play, this character can't be challenged.
flavorText:
"Sullivan’s cousin’s sister’s daughter is a real go-getter. Lots of potential.”
—Henry J. Waternoose III
author: Jeanne Plounevez

name: Jasmine
subtitle: Vine Expert
rulesText: \Shared Resources\ When you play this character, each player draws a card.
flavorText: “This looks like a problem, and I've got a solution!”
author: Lauren Barger

name: Mike Wazowski
subtitle: Well-Rounded Entertainer
rulesText: \Make 'Em Laugh\ When you play this character, you may pay 2 {I} to give chosen character +1 {L} this turn.
flavorText: "Hey, good evening, how are ya? Nice to see ya. I tell you it's great to be here in . . . your room. Where are you from?"
author: French Carlomagno

name: The Horned King
subtitle: Merciless Master
rulesText: \Cauldron's Power\ While this character is exerted, you may play characters from your discard. If you do, they enter play exerted. (You pay all costs.)
author: Denny Minonne

name: Kanga
subtitle: Hunny Bard
rulesText: <Singer> 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to sing songs.)
flavorText: No matter how scary things got, Kanga’s uplifting tunes kept the party’s spirits—and courage—high.
author: Cam Kendell

name: Sulley
subtitle: The New Boss
rulesText:
<Bodyguard> (This character may enter play exerted. An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.) 

\Rehire\ When you play this character, you may return a character card from your discard to your hand.
author: Anna Stosik

name: Mirabel Madrigal
subtitle: Family Guardian
rulesText: \Miraculous Protection\ Whenever you remove damage from one of your characters, you may ready them. If you do, they can't quest or challenge for the rest of this turn.
author: Veronica Di Lorenzo / Livio Cacciatore

name: Ursula
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Energy Sap\ Whenever one of your Floodborn characters quests, chosen opposing character gets -1 {S} until the start of your next turn.
flavorText: The vine-created copy of Vanessa was as dangerous as it was beautiful.
author: Pauline Voss

name: Pocahontas & Meeko
subtitle: Adventurous Friends
rulesText:
<Shift> 2 {I} (You may pay 2 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Pocahontas or Meeko.)

<Evasive>

\Welcome Return\ Whenever this character quests, you may return chosen character of yours with cost 1 to your hand. If you do, you may play a character with cost 1 for free.
author: Amber Kommavongsa

name: Woody & Buzz Lightyear
subtitle: Best Buddies
rulesText:
<Shift> 5 {I} (You may pay 5 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Woody or Buzz Lightyear.) 

\To Infinity . . .\ When you play this character, if chosen opponent has more cards in their hand than you, draw cards until you have the same number.

\. . . And Beyond!\ Whenever this character quests, you may play a card with cost 2 or less for free.
author: Marcel Berg

name: Sulley & Boo
subtitle: Scare Buddies
rulesText:
<Combo Shift> 4 {I} (You may pay 4 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Sulley, one named Boo, or one of each.)

\The Power of Friendship\ When this character is banished, if any of the cards that were under them are character cards, you may play those characters from your discard for free.
author: Mariana Moreno

name: The Madrigal Family
subtitle: Every Generation
rulesText:
<Madrigal Shift> 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your Madrigal characters.)

\Family Blessings\ Once during your turn, whenever you remove 1 or more damage from one of your characters, put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
author: LadyShalirin

name: Lilo & Stitch
subtitle: Fun-Loving Friends
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Lilo or Stitch.)

<Resist> +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)

<Support> (Whenever this character quests, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)
author: Serena Wade

name: If I Didn't Have You
rulesText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 

You and another chosen player each draw 2 cards.
author: Saulo Nate

name: I'm Never Not by Your Side
rulesText:
<Sing Together> 5 (Any number of your or your teammates’ characters with total cost 5 or more may {E} to sing this song for free.)

Remove up to 4 damage total from any number of your characters. You gain 1 lore for each 1 damage removed this way.
author: Koni

name: Besties, Assemble!
rulesText: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a character card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
flavorText:
“We <all> da bomb!”
—Miriam
author: Matt Chapman

name: Nobody Like U
rulesText:
<Sing Together> 5 (Any number of your or your teammates’ characters with total cost 5 or more may {E} to sing this song for free.)
Play a character with cost 4 or less for free.
flavorText: You’re never not on my mind
author: Javi Salas

name: Powhatan's Staff
rulesText: \Step Forward\ {E}, 1 {I} — The next character you play this turn enters play exerted and gains <Bodyguard> until the start of your next turn. (An opposing character who challenges one of your characters must choose one with Bodyguard if able.)
author: Gwawi

name: Rapunzel's Tower
subtitle: Taken by the Vine
rulesText: \Embracing Change\ Your Floodborn characters get +2 {W}.
author: Ha Jung Song

name: Fflewddur Fflam
subtitle: Luckless Bard
rulesText: \Chasing Adventure\ When you play this character, if a character of yours quested this turn, draw a card.
flavorText: "Well, now, I can't say this was unexpected. But still, if you could just set me down gently . . ."
author: Brian Kesinger

name: Maleficent
subtitle: Exultant Spellcaster
flavorText: "Such destruction! Look around—vines as far as the eye can see. And here we sit, at the heart of it."
author: Ornella Savarese

name: Winnie the Pooh
subtitle: Hunny Archmage
rulesText: \Stick Together\ While you have 2 or more other Hunny characters in play, this character gets +2 {L}.
flavorText: Hunnymancy is a powerful magic, suitable only for the pure of heart.
author: Cam Kendell

name: Panic
subtitle: Hammer Enthusiast
rulesText: <Rush> (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
flavorText:
Pain: "Are you sure this is gonna work?"
Panic: "We're about to find out!"
author: Brianna Garcia

name: Lumpy
subtitle: Hunny Druid
rulesText: \Welcome Healing\ When you play this character, you may move up to 2 damage from chosen character to chosen opposing character.
flavorText: “Time for the heffalump healing touch!”
author: Kapik

name: Abu
subtitle: Wise Sultan
rulesText: \Ruler for a Day\ When this character quests, banish him.
flavorText:
"Well, that's just great. I guess anyone can be sultan now."
—Iago
author: Oggy Christiansson

name: Meilin Lee
subtitle: Superficially Obedient
rulesText: \Newfound Confidence\ When you shift a character on top of her, this character gains <Evasive> until the start of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
author: Oggy Christiansson

name: Genie
subtitle: Hard to Grasp
rulesText: <Evasive> (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
flavorText: “Nice try, stinkweed, but there’s only one thing that can contain me.”
author: Hedvig H-S

name: Vixey
subtitle: Expert Fisher
rulesText: \Stealing In\ When you play this character, if you have a character with <Evasive> in play, you may return chosen character, item, or location with cost 2 or less to their player's hand.
flavorText: "I've got my dinner. Where's yours, Tod?"
author: Oggy Christiansson

name: Meeko
subtitle: Lucky Raccoon
flavorText: He didn't know how he was going to carry all of this fruit, but he sure was going to try.
author: Heidi Neunhoffer

name: Pain
subtitle: Running with Scissors
rulesText: \Multipurpose Tool\ When you play this character, if you have a character card named Panic in your discard, gain 2 lore.
flavorText:
"Hey, you were right—this <is> fun!"
—Pain
author: Brianna Garcia

name: Ming Lee
subtitle: Overprotective Parent
rulesText: \You're Grounded\ When you shift a character on top of this character, chosen opposing exerted character can't ready at the start of their next turn.
flavorText: “How could she do this to her own <mother>?”
author: Leonardo Giammichele

name: Merida
subtitle: Wisp Conjurer
rulesText:
\Focused Energy\ This character may enter play exerted to draw a card.

\Beckon\ During your turn, whenever another character of yours enters play exerted, you may draw a card.
author: Javi Salas

name: Mrs. Incredible
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Torrent\ Whenever one of your Floodborn characters quests, you pay 1 {I} less for the next character you shift this turn.
flavorText: The vine's copy took her most valuable possession: her identity.
author: Valerio Buonfantino

name: Pete
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Thorny Overgrowth\ Your Floodborn characters gain <Challenger> +1. (They get +1 {S} while challenging.)
flavorText: Compared to actual Pete glimmers, this vine's copy was almost more pleasant to deal with.
author: Kamil Murzyn

name: Grandma Wu
subtitle: Wise Grandmother
rulesText:
<Challenger> +2 (While challenging, this character gets +2 {S}.) 

\Ancestral Understanding\ When you shift a character on top of this character, gain 1 lore.
author: Pauline Voss

name: Heihei
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Botanical Remedy\ Whenever one of your Floodborn characters quests, you may move 1 damage from chosen character to chosen opposing character.
flavorText: A copy with even less sense than the original.
author: Oggy Christiansson

name: Hera
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Mystical Boon\ Whenever you play this or another Floodborn character, gain 1 lore.
flavorText: You could do a lot worse than make a copy of a goddess.
author: Julian del Rey

name: Tinker Bell
subtitle: Finding a Way
flavorText:
"Tink, what do you see over there? Do you think we can get in?"
—Peter Pan
author: Giulia Riva

name: Morph
subtitle: Little Imitator
rulesText: \Advanced Mimicry\ You can shift any character on top of this character. (This includes all Shift variants.)
flavorText:
"Listen up. I've got a <special> job for you."
—John Silver
author: Brian Weisz

name: Peter Pan
subtitle: Playful Prankster
rulesText: \Stay Right There\ When you play this character, chosen opposing character can't ready at the start of their next turn.
flavorText: "I've never met a problem I couldn't solve."
author: Maria Dresden

name: Aladdin & Genie
subtitle: Mischievous Pals
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Aladdin or Genie.)

\Sleight of Hand\ When you play this character, you may put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you do, draw that number of cards plus 1.
author: Natalia Trykowska

name: Peter Pan & Tinker Bell
subtitle: Fast Friends
rulesText:
<Shift> 4 {I} (You may pay 4 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Peter Pan or Tinker Bell.)

\You Can Fly!\ Your characters gain <Evasive>. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
author: Alice Pisoni

name: Christopher Robin
subtitle: Hunny Sage
rulesText:
\Gather the Party\ You can have other Hunny characters in your deck regardless of ink type.

\Magical Summons\ When you play this character, you may search your deck for a Hunny card, reveal it, and put it in your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck.
author: Kapik

name: Winnie the Pooh & Piglet
subtitle: Hunny Mages
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Winnie the Pooh or Piglet.)

\Magical Mix\ This character gets +1 {L} for each different ink type of characters you have in play.
author: Valerio Buonfantino

name: Maleficent & Diablo
subtitle: Evil Incarnate
rulesText:
<Shift> 5 {I} (You may pay 5 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Maleficent or Diablo.)

\Fools!\ You may put 5 character cards from your discard on the bottom of your deck in any order to shift this character for free.

\Raven's Call\ During your turn, whenever this character exerts, draw a card.
author: Eri Welli

name: You've Got Some Punch
rulesText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 

Chosen character gains <Rush> and <Challenger> +2 this turn. (They can challenge the turn they're played. They get +2 {S} while challenging.)
author: Amanda Duarte

name: With a Few Good Friends
rulesText:
<Sing Together> 6 (Any number of your or your teammates’ characters with total cost 6 or more may {E} to sing this song for free.)

Chosen player draws a card for each different ink type of characters you have in play.
author: Cam Kendell

name: Petrify
rulesText: Exert chosen opposing character.
flavorText:
"What's making that awful noise? It sounds like it's coming our way."
—Shanzay, an Illumineer
author: Geoffrey Boudout

name: One and Only
rulesText: Choose a character. Banish all other characters with the same name as that character.
flavorText: "Is that. . . . me? The vine made a copy of <me> to defend itself?!"
author: Saulo Nate

name: Protective Aura
rulesText: Your Floodborn characters gain <Evasive> until the start of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
flavorText: The glow of the vine-created replicas was beautiful . . . but unsettling.
author: Lauren Levering

name: Narrow Escape
rulesText: Return up to 2 chosen characters, items, or locations with cost 2 or less each to their player's hand.
author: Matt Chapman

name: Broken Pod
rulesText: \Renewal Process\ {E}, 1 {I} — Put a card from chosen player's discard on the bottom of their deck.
flavorText:
"Looks like another vineling's on the loose. Let's go get it." 
—Venturo, an Illumineer
author: Alex Accorsi / Leonardo Giammichele

name: Magical Hunny Staff
rulesText:
\Gift of the Hive\ Once during your turn, you may pay 1 {I} to give chosen character of yours the Hunny classification until the start of your next turn.

\Spell of Swiftness\ {E}, 2 {I} — Chosen Hunny character of yours gains <Evasive> until the start of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
author: Kaitlin Cuthbertson

name: Source of the Vine
rulesText:
\Siphon\ Whenever an opposing character quests, you gain 1 lore unless their player pays 1 {I}.

\Radiant Bloom\ {E}, 2 {I} — Gain 1 lore.
flavorText:
"Soon it'll drain every drop of ink in Lorcana . . ."
—Hana, an Illumineer
author: Andrew Theophilopoulos

name: Ring of Stones
subtitle: Taken by the Vine
rulesText: \Deep Wisdom\ Your Floodborn characters get +1 {L}.
flavorText: The tendrils wrapped around each stone, searching for more ink.
author: Jeremy Adams

name: Carl Fredricksen
subtitle: Loving Husband
rulesText: \Take My Hand\ When you play this character, you pay 2 {I} less for the next character named Ellie Fredricksen you play this turn.
flavorText: “You know, Ellie, I think we’re going to be together forever.”
author: Mariana Moreno

name: Ellie Fredricksen
subtitle: Loving Wife
rulesText: \Adventurous Heart\ Whenever you play a location, gain 1 lore.
flavorText: "Every moment we're together is an adventure."
author: Mariana Moreno

name: Buzz Lightyear
subtitle: Grounded
rulesText: \Not a Flying Toy\ This character can't gain <Evasive>.
flavorText: "Star Command, the foliage on this planet is uniquely disarming."
author: Omar Lozano

name: Buzz Lightyear
subtitle: Providing Cover
rulesText:
\Action Figure\ When you play this character, choose one of the following. If you have another Toy character in play, choose both instead:
• You may return an action card with cost 2 or less from your discard to your hand.
• You may play an action with cost 2 or less for free.
author: Marcel Berg

name: Gopher
subtitle: Hunny Cook
rulesText:
\Down the Hole\ This character may enter play exerted.

\Fortifying Meal\ During an opponent's turn, while this character is exerted, your other Hunny characters gain <Resist> +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
author: French Carlomagno

name: Russell
subtitle: Senior Wilderness Explorer
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Russell.)

\Base Camp\ Your characters at locations get +1 {S}.

\Good Leadership\ Whenever one of your characters with 4 {S} or more quests, gain 1 lore.
author: João Moura

name: Rapunzel
subtitle: Tower Defender
rulesText: \The Fates' Design\ When you play this character, you may choose and discard a card. If you do, return chosen character to their player's hand.
flavorText: "I . . . said . . . GET . . . OUT!"
author: Alice Pisoni

name: Tod
subtitle: Clever Fox
rulesText: \Problem Solving\ When you play this character, draw 2 cards, then choose and discard a card.
flavorText: “This would be a lot easier if these vines tasted better."
author: Noukah

name: Russell
subtitle: Junior Wilderness Explorer
rulesText: \Assisting the Elderly Badge\ Whenever this character quests, you may move him and one of your other characters to the same location for free.
flavorText: “An Explorer is a friend to all, be it plants or fish or tiny mole.”
author: Kendall Hale

name: Roo
subtitle: Hunny Rogue
rulesText:
<Ward> (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)

\Elusive Expertise\ While you have another Hunny character in play, this character gains <Evasive>. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
author: Gonzalo Kenny

name: Winifred
subtitle: Exasperated Elephant
rulesText: <Ward> (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
flavorText: "Hathi! Stop yapping about your medal and do something about this renegade vegetation!”
author: Noukah

name: Aladdin
subtitle: Doing His Part
rulesText: \Clear It Out\ When you play this character, you may pay 1 {I} to banish chosen item.
flavorText: “I don’t know what that is, but let's send it back where it came from.”
author: Alejandro Hernandez

name: Madam Mim
subtitle: Hummingbird
rulesText:
<Evasive> (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

\Just How I Like It\ All cards in your hand count as having {C}.
author: Luis Huerta

name: Minnie Mouse
subtitle: Curious Adventurer
flavorText: Minnie peered through the snarl of thorns. Was that a narrow passage into the vine? She wondered how far it might go.
author: Rachel Elese

name: Kevin
subtitle: Flightless Bird
rulesText: \Back to the Nest\ Whenever this character quests, put this card on the top of your deck.
flavorText:
"She has been gathering food for her babies and must get back to them."
—Dug
author: Jiahui Eva Gao

name: Peter Pan
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Clever Trick\ Whenever one of your Floodborn characters is challenged, the challenging player chooses and discards a card.
flavorText: The replicas the vine created glowed with an infusion of mixed ink.
author: Simone Giovanardi

name: Copper
subtitle: Creative Storyteller
flavorText:
"And then Chief was sleeping, but the vine touched his leg, and he jumped up in the air like <this>!"
—Copper
author: Brian Weisz

name: Posey
subtitle: Vampire Potato
rulesText: <Potato Shift> 5 {I} (You may pay 5 {I} to play this on top of one of your items named Potato.)
flavorText:
“She’s alive! Alive, I tell you!”
—Dr. Bushroot
author: Carmine Pucci

name: Dr. Bushroot
subtitle: Evil Botanist
rulesText:
<Ward> (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)

\Fair is Fair\ Whenever this character is challenged, chosen opponent chooses and discards a card.
author: Kamil Murzyn

name: Mother Gothel
subtitle: Evil as Ever
rulesText: \Mummy's Back\ During your turn, when you discard this card, you may play this character from your discard. (You pay all costs.)
flavorText: "Well, I'm glad <somebody> let me up!"
author: Yrgane Ramon

name: Tod & Copper
subtitle: Best of Friends
rulesText:
<Shift> 2 {I} (You may pay 2 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Tod or Copper.)

<Evasive> (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
author: Sandara Tang

name: Rapunzel
subtitle: Escaping the Tower
rulesText: \The Call of Adventure\ Once during your turn, you may discard a card to give this character +1 {L} and <Evasive> until the start of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
author: Emily Abeydeera

name: Cetus
subtitle: Mighty Serpent
flavorText:
"Okay, so this vine? Not in my plans. But I'm a resourceful god. Gotta roll with punches. Adapt. Bring out the sea serpent."
—Hades
author: Celeste Jamneck

name: Mushu
subtitle: Stealthy Dragon
rulesText:
<Evasive> (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

\Tip the Scales\ Whenever this character quests, if an opponent has more cards in their hand than you, you may draw a card.
author: Tom Bancroft / Kristen Breshears

name: Carl Fredricksen & Russell
subtitle: Intrepid Explorers
rulesText:
<Shift> 4 {I} (You may pay 4 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Carl Fredricksen or Russell.)

\Outdoor Skills\ While this character is at a location, all characters at that location get +1 {L} and gain <Evasive>. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
author: Natalie Dombois

name: Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse
subtitle: Adventuring Duo
rulesText:
<Duo Shift> 0 {I} (You may pay 0 {I} to play this on top of two of your characters, one named Mickey Mouse and one named Minnie Mouse.)

\Thinking of You\ If this character would be banished, put them into your inkwell facedown and exerted instead.
author: Rachel Elese

name: Rapunzel & Flynn Rider
subtitle: Unlikely Pair
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Rapunzel or Flynn Rider.)

\Clever Swap\ Whenever this character quests, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.

\Fresh Start\ During your turn, whenever you discard a character card, you may play that character from your discard. (You pay all costs.)
author: Shannon Hallstein

name: To Wither a Flower
rulesText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 

Deal 2 damage to each opposing damaged character.
author: Kasia Brzezinska

name: Piercing Attack
rulesText: Deal 2 damage to chosen character. This damage can't be reduced by <Resist>.
author: Andrew Theophilopoulos

name: Put That Thing Back
rulesText:
(A character with cost 4 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 

Return chosen character or item to their player's hand.
flavorText: . . . Where it came from or so help me
author: Kevin Sidharta

name: Scout Ahead
rulesText: If an opponent has more lore than you, gain 2 lore.
flavorText: When the odds seem longest, Mickey and Minnie will find their way through.
author: Rachel Elese

name: Potato
rulesText: \Full of Potential\ This item enters play exerted.
flavorText: It doesn't have much flavor.
author: Simone Giovanardi

name: My Adventure Book
rulesText: \New Memories\ {E}, 1 {I} — Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a non-character card or a character card named Kevin, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
flavorText: "Thanks for the adventure—now go have a new one! Love, Ellie"
author: McKay Anderson

name: Vine Pod
rulesText:
\Fragile Husk\ This item enters play exerted.

\Regenerate\ {E}, 1 {I} — Banish chosen character of yours. You may play a character with the same name as that character for free.
author: Sarah Schmidt

name: Paradise Falls
subtitle: Exotic Destination
rulesText: \Quite a Sight\ While you have a character here, this location gets +3 {L}.
flavorText: A land lost in time.
author: Jaime Puga

name: Dash Parr
subtitle: Super Fast
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Dash Parr.)

<Evasive> (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

\Follow Me!\ Whenever this character quests, you may reveal the top card of your deck. If you do, you may play it. Otherwise, put it into your discard. (You pay all costs.)
author: Mike Parker

name: Yzma
subtitle: Choosy Customer
rulesText: \Get This Right\ When you play this character, each opponent loses 1 lore.
flavorText: "Is there anything on this menu that isn't swimming in gravy?"
author: Lissette Carrera

name: Kuzco
subtitle: Picky Customer
flavorText: "Give me the chili cheese sampler, hold the chili and put the cheese on the side. Oh, and extra gravy . . . Hey! Are you listening? I'm ordering here!"
author: Lissette Carrera / Brett Owens

name: The Bear
subtitle: Territorial Animal
rulesText: \Savage Fury\ While this character has damage, he gets +3 {S}.
flavorText:
"Look, Copper. The vine's no match for that bear!"
—Amos Slade
author: Alexandria Neonakis

name: Carl Fredricksen
subtitle: On the Move
rulesText:
\Moving Partner\ Whenever you play a location, you may move this character and up to 1 of your other characters to that location for free. 

\Adventure Awaits\ Whenever this character quests while at a location, draw cards equal to that location's {L}.
author: Rodrigo Camilo

name: Dash Parr
subtitle: Dodgeball Dynamo
rulesText: <Evasive> (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)
flavorText: "Hey look, I'm here! No wait, I'm over here now! Nope, back here again!"
author: Mike Parker

name: Gaston
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Drawing Strength\ Your Floodborn characters get +1 {S}.
flavorText:
"Of course the vine would copy me. Look at him! He's almost as handsome as I am."
—Gaston
author: Eri Welli

name: Colonel Hathi
subtitle: On the March
rulesText: \Hup, Two, Three, Four\ Whenever this character quests, you may move him to one of your locations for free.
flavorText: "March, march, march. No complaining."
author: Michaela Martin

name: Splodyhead
subtitle: Experiment 619
flavorText:
"Is ideal experiment for making of campfires, roasting of marshmallows, and also blowing up of things."
—Jumba Jookiba
author: Heidi Neunhoffer

name: Pacha
subtitle: Panicked Customer
rulesText:
<Reckless> (This character can't quest and must challenge each turn if able.)

\Adrenaline Surge\ During your turn, this character gets +4 {S}.
author: Ha Jung Song

name: Sun Yee
subtitle: Red Panda Spirit
rulesText: <Temporary Red Panda Shift> 2 {I} (You may pay 2 {I} to play this on top of one of your Red Panda characters. At the end of your turn, remove all damage from this character and return only this card to your hand.)
author: Kapik

name: Grandma Wu
subtitle: Fierce Red Panda
rulesText:
<Temporary Shift> 4 {I} (You may pay 4 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Grandma Wu. At the end of your turn, remove all damage from this character and return only this card to your hand.)

\Intimidating Charge\ Whenever this character challenges another character, you gain 2 lore and each opponent loses 2 lore.
author: Malia Ewart

name: King Louie
subtitle: King of Swing
rulesText: <Singer> 6 (This character counts as cost 6 to sing songs.)
flavorText: "Come on, groove with ol' King Louie. You cats need to relax!"
author: Lauren Levering

name: Beast
subtitle: Fierce Defender
rulesText: \Formidable Love\ While you have a character named Belle in play, this character gets +2 {S}.
flavorText: The Beast treasured two things above all: the enchanted rose and the love who could break his curse.
author: Diogo Saito

name: Randall Boggs
subtitle: Envious Coworker
rulesText:
<Evasive> (Only characters with Evasive can challenge this character.)

\After-Hours Project\ While all cards in your inkwell are exerted, this character gets +2 {L}.
author: Edu Francisco

name: Donald Duck
subtitle: Vineling Rider
rulesText: <Rush> (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
flavorText:
Mickey Mouse: "I wouldn't do that, Donald!"
Donald Duck: "That's why I have more fun!"
author: Lissette Carrera

name: Meilin Lee
subtitle: Popular Red Panda
rulesText:
<Temporary Shift> 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Meilin Lee. At the end of your turn, remove all damage from this character and return only this card to your hand.)

\Karaoke Queen\ Once during your turn, whenever this character sings a song, gain 3 lore.
author: Koni

name: Tigger
subtitle: Hunny Barbarian
rulesText:
<Reckless> (This character can't quest and must challenge each turn if able.)

\Protective Charge\ Once during your turn, whenever this character challenges another character, you may ready chosen Hunny character. If you do, that character can't quest for the rest of this turn.
author: Simone Giovanardi

name: Boo
subtitle: Energetic Child
rulesText:
<Rush> (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)

\Kid-Tastrophe!\ Whenever this character challenges another character with 3 {S} or less, banish that character. (No damage is dealt in that challenge.)
author: Malia Ewart

name: Sulley
subtitle: Protective Monster
rulesText:
\Fearsome Glare\ When you play this character, you may exert all cards in your inkwell.
 
\Riled Up\ While all cards in your inkwell are exerted, this character gains <Rush>. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
author: Simone Tentoni

name: Ming Lee
subtitle: Giant Red Panda
rulesText:
<Temporary Shift> 7 {I} (You may pay 7 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Ming Lee. At the end of your turn, remove all damage from this character and return only this card to your hand.)

\Path of Destruction\ Whenever this character challenges another character, ready her. She can't quest for the rest of this turn.
author: Grace Tran

name: Captain Hook
subtitle: Conniving Pirate
rulesText: \Have At You\ Whenever this character challenges another character, gain 1 lore.
flavorText: “Smee! We have some uninvited guests—time to show them our famed hospitality."
author: Javi Salas

name: Peter Pan
subtitle: Vine Duelist
flavorText: "Come on, you big bully. You've gotta be faster than that!"
author: Clio Schaffner

name: Belle & Beast
subtitle: Certain as the Sun
rulesText:
<Shift> 6 {I} (You may pay 6 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Belle or Beast.)

\Inspiring Dance\ Whenever this character quests, ready all cards in your inkwell.

\Appreciative Audience\ 6 {I} — Ready your other characters. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
author: Ian MacDonald

name: Dash Parr & Violet Parr
subtitle: Super Siblings
rulesText:
<Combo Shift> 6 {I} (You may pay 6 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Dash Parr, one named Violet Parr, or one of each.)

<Evasive>, <Resist> +1
\Incredible Tactics\ Whenever this character quests or challenges, draw a card for each card under them.
author: Mike Parker

name: Red Moon Ritual
rulesText:
<Sing Together> 7 (Any number of your or your teammates’ characters with total cost 7 or more may {E} to sing this song for free.)

Banish chosen character.
author: Kasia Brzezinska

name: Red Alert
rulesText: Banish chosen character with 3 {S} or less. If you have a Monster character in play, chosen opponent loses 1 lore.
flavorText:
“Please remain calm. This is not a drill.”
—CDA Agent
author: Ian MacDonald

name: RAHR!
rulesText: Chosen character gets +3 {S} this turn.
flavorText:
"Did you see the look on my face? It was the scariest one yet!"
—Mike Wazowski
author: Kevin Sidharta

name: Prophetic Vision
rulesText: Shuffle your deck, then reveal the top card. If it's an action card, you may play it for free. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck, then each opponent loses 1 lore and you gain 1 lore.
flavorText: The vision showed the city but not the source of its power.
author: Jules Dubost

name: It's Gonna Be Great!
rulesText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 

Ready chosen character. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
author: Serena Wade

name: Scream Canister
rulesText: \Erratic Screams\ {E}, 2 {I} — Exert all cards in your inkwell. Exert chosen opposing character with 2 {S} or less.
flavorText: "'Those screams are unstable, Randall.' Pffft.  Maybe for <you>, you big hairball."
author: Luis Huerta

name: Bunch of Balloons
rulesText:
\Float Away\ When you play this item, choose a location of yours. While this item is in play, that location gains <Evasive>. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge it.)

\Out of Sight\ 3 {I} — Return this item to your hand.
author: Wietse Treurniet

name: Beast's Castle
subtitle: Overrun by the Vine
rulesText: \Imminent Threat\ Your Floodborn characters gain <Rush>. (They can challenge the turn they're played.)
flavorText: A deep rumble echoed through the forest as the vine ripped the castle from its foundation.
author: Jimmy Lo

name: Carl's House
subtitle: Flying High
rulesText: \Moving Day\ Once during your turn, you may move chosen character from here to another location for free. If you do, gain 1 lore.
author: Wietse Treurniet

name: Launchpad
subtitle: Sky Patrol
rulesText: <Alert> (This character can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
flavorText:
Launchpad: “Don’t worry, DW, I’ll make sure we crash there safely!” 
Darkwing Duck: “That’s what I'm afraid of.”
author: Lissette Carrera

name: Dug
subtitle: Good Boy
rulesText: \Fetch!\ When you play this character, if you have an item in play, draw a card.
flavorText: “A ball! Oh boy, oh boy, a ball!”
author: Kendall Hale

name: Roz
subtitle: Always Watching
rulesText: \Always\ Each opponent plays with the top card of their deck faceup.
flavorText: "And I'm sure you filed your paperwork correctly. For once."
author: Matteo Marzocco

name: Merlin
subtitle: Envisioning the Future
rulesText:
\Minor Trickery\ When you play this character, you may draw a card from the bottom of your deck.

\Age of Inconvenience\ When this character is banished, put this card from your discard on the bottom of your deck.
author: Carmine Pucci

name: Quackerjack
subtitle: Loony Toymaker
rulesText: \Evil Design\ When you play this character and whenever he quests, put the top 4 cards of your deck into your discard. You may deal 1 damage to chosen character for each item card put into your discard this way.
author: Simone Giovanardi

name: Belle
subtitle: Always Reading
rulesText: \Dreaming of More\ You pay 1 {I} less to shift a character on top of this character.
flavorText: “I just finished the most wonderful story about a beanstalk and an ogre . . ."
author: Pauline Voss

name: Ellie Fredricksen
subtitle: Adventure Partner
rulesText: \Always with You\ When this character is banished, you may put this card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
flavorText: “Adventure has a way of finding us wherever we go.”
author: Yrgane Ramon

name: Mrs. Hasagawa
subtitle: Fruit Vendor
flavorText: The old woman turned as the vine's shadow fell over her fruit stand. "Hello, dear! More mangoes today?"
author: Svetlozara Nikolova

name: Alpha
subtitle: Pack Leader
rulesText: \Who Wants a Treat?\ Whenever you play an item, chosen character gets +1 {S} and gains <Resist> +1 this turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
flavorText: “Now we will find the small mailman and The One Who Smells of Prunes.”
author: Carmine Pucci

name: Sulley
subtitle: Strategic Scarer
rulesText: \Jump Scare\ While you have 5 or more cards in your inkwell, this character gets +2 {S}.
flavorText:
"Show them what it takes to be our top scarer!"
—Henry J. Waternoose III
author: Jiahui Eva Gao

name: Randall Boggs
subtitle: Scary Smart
rulesText:
\Get Outta Here!\ When you play this character, put chosen character of yours into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

\Devious Plan\ At the end of your turn, if all cards in your inkwell are exerted, gain 1 lore.
author: Kendall Hale

name: Piglet
subtitle: Hunny Mage Apprentice
flavorText:
“It’s okay, Piglet. Being scared doesn’t mean you’re not brave. In fact, I think you can only be brave if you’re scared first!”
—Christopher Robin, Hunny Sage
author: Marta Andreeva

name: Mickey Mouse
subtitle: Inquisitive Explorer
flavorText: "Oh boy, I knew climbing this vine would be worth it. There's so much to see up here!"
author: David Otalora

name: Hades
subtitle: Meticulous Schemer
rulesText: <Ward> (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)
flavorText: "This little guy is so hideous! I love it! And the way it sucks up flood ink? Even I couldn't have planned it any better."
author: Julian del Rey

name: Antonio Madrigal
subtitle: Animal Doctor
rulesText: \Healing Hands\ When you play this character, you may remove up to 3 damage from chosen character of yours. If you removed damage this way, put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
author: Marta Andreeva

name: Maid Marian
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Inkflow\ Whenever one of your Floodborn characters is banished, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
author: Matteo Marzocco

name: Robin Hood
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Keen-Eyed\ Your Floodborn characters gain <Alert>. (They can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
flavorText: The vine created defenders to keep silent watch on the surrounding lands.
author: Matteo Marzocco

name: Boo
subtitle: Human Child
rulesText: \Making Memories\ While you have 5 or more cards in your inkwell, this character gets +2 {L}.
flavorText: For the rest of her life, Boo would remember her friend, Kitty.
author: Eri Welli

name: Pluto
subtitle: Suspicious Sentry
rulesText: <Support> (Whenever this character quests, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)
flavorText: He didn't like the smell of that vine one bit.
author: Aurélie Lise-Anne

name: Charles Muntz
subtitle: Obsessive Explorer
rulesText:
\Useful Gear\ Whenever you play an item, look at the top card of your deck. Put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.

\Find That Bird!\ Whenever this character quests, look at the top card of your deck. If it's a character card named Kevin, you may reveal it and put it into your hand to gain 3 lore. Otherwise, put it on either the top or the bottom of your deck.
author: Cristian Romero

name: Henry J. Waternoose III
subtitle: Chief Executive Officer
rulesText: \The Bottom Line\ While you have more cards in your inkwell than each opposing player, this character gets +2 {L} and gains <Ward>. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
author: Edu Francisco

name: Eeyore
subtitle: Hunny Scholar
rulesText: \Hunny Tactics\ Whenever this character quests, chosen Hunny character of yours gets +1 {L} and gains <Ward> until the start of your next turn. (Opponents can't choose them except to challenge.)
flavorText: "It’s okay. Pile more things on. I’ll be fine.”
author: Grace Tran

name: Darkwing Duck & Launchpad
subtitle: St. Canard's Finest
rulesText:
<Shift> 5 {I} (You may pay 5 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Darkwing Duck or Launchpad.)

<Ward> (Opponents can't choose this character except to challenge.)

\Victory Pose\ During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.
author: Carlos Luzzi

name: Power Surge
rulesText: Each player puts the top 2 cards of their deck into their inkwell facedown and exerted.
flavorText:
Sulley: "What was that?" 
Mike: "I have no idea, but it would be really great if it didn’t do it again."
author: Jaime Puga

name: Focused Search
rulesText: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. You may reveal a character card named Kevin or an item card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order.
author: Oggy Christiansson

name: We've Got a Lot to Do!
rulesText:
(A character with cost 3 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 

Put chosen item or location into its player's inkwell facedown and exerted.
author: Brian Kesinger

name: Startle
rulesText: Chosen character gets -3 {S} this turn.
flavorText:
“Hey, careful, buddy! That’s not me. That's a vine copy of me!"
—Aladdin
author: Matt Chapman

name: Closet Door Portal
rulesText:
\Knock, Knock\ This item enters play exerted.

\Who's There?\ {E}, 2 {I} — Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a character, item, or location card with cost 6 or less and play it for free. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in any order. Put this card into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
author: Jaime Puga

name: Hana's Inkcaster
rulesText: \Rejuvenating Flourish\ {E} — Remove up to 2 damage from chosen character. If there's a card under that character, they gain <Resist> +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
author: Moniek Schilder

name: Laugh Canister
rulesText: \Copycat\ {E} — Put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted. Chosen opponent may put the top card of their deck into their inkwell facedown and exerted.
author: Rudy Hill

name: Translation Collar
rulesText: \You Are My Friend\ {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gets +1 {L} and gains <Support> this turn. (Whenever they quest, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)
flavorText: "SQUIRREL!"
author: Peter Brockhammer

name: Big Book of Hunny
rulesText: \Invoke Hunny\ {E}, 2 {I} — Reveal the top card of your deck. If it's a Hunny card, put it into your hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
author: Kaitlin Cuthbertson

name: Hundred Acre Wood
subtitle: Hunny Campsite
rulesText:
\Home Away from Home\ Characters get +1 {W} while here.

\Hunny Quest\ Hunny characters get +1 {L} while here.
author: Jeremy Adams / Jaime Puga

name: Violet Parr
subtitle: Super Resilient
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Violet Parr.)

<Resist> +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)

\Heroic Synergy\ Whenever you play this or another Hero character, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
author: Mike Parker

name: Aladdin
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \The Vine Provides\ Whenever one of your Floodborn characters quests, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
flavorText:
"Wait, that's not an Aladdin glimmer—that's a vineling replica!" 
—Shanzay, an Illumineer
author: Alejandro Hernandez

name: Willie the Giant
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Defend the Stalk\ Your Floodborn characters gain <Resist> +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
flavorText: The vine's embrace helped shield its replicas from harm.
author: Caro Waro

name: Sprout
subtitle: Experiment 509
rulesText:
<Resist> +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)

\Botanical Evil\ When you play this character, you may choose and discard an Alien character card or a location card from your hand. If you do, deal 2 damage to chosen character.
author: Chemène de Heus

name: Stitch
subtitle: Protector of Frogs
flavorText: "MY frog! It is very important!"
author: Patri Balanovsky

name: Sheriff of Nottingham
subtitle: Vine Slayer
rulesText: <Challenger> +3 (While challenging, this character gets +3 {S}.)
flavorText: “Now, look here, you overgrown weed . . ."
author: Federico Maria Cugliari

name: Mata
subtitle: Meat Hut Waitress
flavorText: "Three pork combos, extra bacon on the side, two chili cheese samplers, a basket of liver and onion rings, a catch of the day, and a steak cut in the shape of a trout."
author: Celeste Jamneck

name: Violet Parr
subtitle: Force Field Practice
rulesText: <Resist> +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)
flavorText: "Mom? I'm sorry to call you, but um, I think there's a pretty big problem outside the house."
author: Javi Salas

name: Dr. Hamsterviel
subtitle: Evil Observer
rulesText: <Alert> (This character can challenge as if they had Evasive.)
flavorText: "No one can hide from me. From here I can see <everything>!"
author: Chemène de Heus

name: Owl
subtitle: Hunny Ranger
rulesText: \Hunny Alliance\ While you have another Hunny character in play, this character gains <Resist> +2. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
author: Yu Nguyen

name: Megavolt
subtitle: Electrical Menace
rulesText: \Force Field\ While you have no cards in your hand, this character gains <Resist> +2. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
flavorText:
“This guy’s a real live wire!”
—Launchpad
author: Emily Abeydeera

name: Darkwing Duck
subtitle: Shadowy Superhero
rulesText: \Preemptive Strike\ When you play this character, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.
flavorText: “No one messes with Darkwing Duck and gets away with it!”
author: Louis Jones

name: Omnidroid
subtitle: Scanning for Threats
rulesText: \Factory Settings\ While this character has no damage, it gets +2 {S}.
flavorText:
“All right, let’s see who’s gonna be facing <this> bad boy!”
—Syndrome
author: Carlos Ruiz

name: Flynn Rider
subtitle: High-Climbing Rogue
rulesText: \We Can Work This Out\ Whenever an opponent chooses this character for an action or ability, they choose and discard a card.
author: Luca Pinelli

name: The Irate Chef
subtitle: Meat Hut Cook
flavorText:
"All right, buster, that's it! You want a special order, then <you> make it!"
—The Irate Chef
author: Matt Chapman

name: Kronk
subtitle: Meat Hut Cook
rulesText:
<Resist> +1 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 1.)

\Pickup!\ Once during your turn, you may pay 1 {I} to draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
flavorText: "You want that extra crispy?"
author: Diego Machuca

name: Mulan
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Demolish\ Whenever you play this or another Floodborn character, you may banish chosen item.
flavorText: This replica is just as good in a fight as the original—no training necessary.
author: Aubrey Archer

name: Diablo
subtitle: Protecting His Mistress
rulesText: \Flurry of Feathers\ Your characters named Maleficent gain <Resist> +1. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
flavorText:
"You are the only one I can trust, my pet."
—Maleficent
author: Liz Richards

name: Scar
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText:
\Victor's Reward\ During your turn, whenever one of your Floodborn characters banishes another character in a challenge, gain 1 lore.

\Fill the Ranks\ During an opponent's turn, whenever one of your Floodborn characters is banished, draw a card.
author: Therese Vildefall

name: Maximus
subtitle: Relentless Stallion
rulesText: \No Escape\ If you discarded a card this turn, this character gains <Challenger> +2 and can challenge ready characters this turn. (They get +2 {S} while challenging.)
author: Therese Vildefall

name: Omnidroid
subtitle: Ultimate Iteration
rulesText:
<Shift> 6 {I} (You may pay 6 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Omnidroid.)

<Resist> +2 (Damage dealt to this character is reduced by 2.)

\Return on Investment\ When you shift this character, you may return all cards under it to your hand.
author: Sam Nielson

name: The Vine
subtitle: Towering Stalk
rulesText:
<Floodborn Shift> 7 {I} (You may pay 7 {I} to play this on top of one of your Floodborn characters.)
 
\Saturate\ Your other exerted Floodborn characters gain <Bodyguard>.

\Hostile Swarm\ During an opponent's turn, whenever one of your Floodborn characters is banished, deal 1 damage to each opposing character.
author: Nicholas Kole

name: Cower Before Me!
rulesText: Up to 2 chosen opposing characters can't challenge during their next turn.
author: Viv Tanner

name: We'll Save Our Village
rulesText:
(A character with cost 2 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 

Your characters and locations gain <Resist> +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
author: Emily Abeydeera

name: Look What You've Done
rulesText: Deal 2 damage to chosen character. During your turn, when you discard this card, you may play it from your discard. (You pay all costs.)
author: Juan Diego León

name: You Broke My Smolder
rulesText: Discard your hand. Draw 2 cards.
flavorText: "You know, this happens a lot more often than you'd think."
author: Emily Abeydeera

name: Attack of the Vine!
rulesText: Your Floodborn characters gain <Resist> +2 and can challenge ready characters this turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 2.)
author: Max Ulichney

name: Windstorm
rulesText: Deal 1 damage to each opposing character and location. Then, deal 2 damage to each opposing character with <Evasive> and each opposing location with <Evasive>.
author: Andreas Rocha

name: Discarded Armor
rulesText: \Found Equipment\ {E} — If you discarded a card this turn, chosen character of yours gains <Resist> +1 until the start of your next turn. (Damage dealt to them is reduced by 1.)
author: Kaitlin Cuthbertson

name: The Weedwhacker
rulesText:
\Full Power\ {E}, 1 {I} — Chosen character gains <Challenger> +2 this turn. (They get +2 {S} while challenging.)

\Clear-Cut\ 2 {I}, Banish this item — Banish chosen Vineling character.
author: Lissette Carrera

name: Absorbing Bloom
rulesText: \Metamorphosis\ {E}, 1 {I} — If a character was banished in a challenge this turn, draw a card.
flavorText:
"Oh, this is fascinating! How does it do that?"
—Hana, an Illumineer
author: Andrew Peña / Sergio Mancinelli

name: Vine Entrance
subtitle: Ominous Passageway
rulesText: \Root of Power\ The first time a Floodborn character moves here each turn, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.
author: Douglas De La Hoz

name: Mrs. Incredible
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Torrent\ Whenever one of your Floodborn characters quests, you pay 1 {I} less for the next character you shift this turn.
flavorText: The vine's copy took her most valuable possession: her identity.
author: Valerio Buonfantino

name: Peter Pan
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Clever Trick\ Whenever one of your Floodborn characters is challenged, the challenging player chooses and discards a card.
flavorText: The replicas the vine created glowed with an infusion of mixed ink.
author: Simone Giovanardi

name: Mulan
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText: \Demolish\ Whenever you play this or another Floodborn character, you may banish chosen item.
flavorText: This replica is just as good in a fight as the original—no training necessary.
author: Aubrey Archer

name: Mike Wazowski
subtitle: Heroic Climber
rulesText: \Find a Friend\ When you play this character and whenever he quests, each player reveals the top card of their deck. If it's a character card, they may put it into their hand. Otherwise, put it on the bottom of their deck.
author: Lyle Cruse

name: Pocahontas & Meeko
subtitle: Adventurous Friends
rulesText:
<Shift> 2 {I}

<Evasive>

\Welcome Return\ Whenever this character quests, you may return chosen character of yours with cost 1 to your hand. If you do, you may play a character with cost 1 for free.
author: Clio Schaffner

name: Woody & Buzz Lightyear
subtitle: Best Buddies
rulesText:
<Shift> 5 {I}

\To Infinity . . .\ When you play this character, if chosen opponent has more cards in their hand than you, draw cards until you have the same number.

\. . . And Beyond!\ Whenever this character quests, you may play a card with cost 2 or less for free.
author: Giacomo Boni

name: Sulley & Boo
subtitle: Scare Buddies
rulesText:
<Combo Shift> 4 {I}

\The Power of Friendship\ When this character is banished, if any of the cards that were under them are character cards, you may play those characters from your discard for free.
author: Mariana Moreno

name: The Madrigal Family
subtitle: Every Generation
rulesText:
<Madrigal Shift> 3 {I}

\Family Blessings\ Once during your turn, whenever you remove 1 or more damage from one of your characters, put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
author: Maxine Vee

name: Merida
subtitle: Wisp Conjurer
rulesText:
\Focused Energy\ This character may enter play exerted to draw a card.

\Beckon\ During your turn, whenever another character of yours enters play exerted, you may draw a card.
author: Kendall Hale

name: Aladdin & Genie
subtitle: Mischievous Pals
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I}

\Sleight of Hand\ When you play this character, you may put any number of cards from your hand on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you do, draw that number of cards plus 1.
author: Nuel Salinas / Palo Graglia

name: Peter Pan & Tinker Bell
subtitle: Fast Friends
rulesText:
<Shift> 4 {I}

\You Can Fly!\ Your characters gain <Evasive>.
author: Alice Pisoni

name: Winnie the Pooh & Piglet
subtitle: Hunny Mages
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I}

\Magical Mix\ This character gets +1 {L} for each different ink type of characters you have in play.
author: Koni

name: Maleficent & Diablo
subtitle: Evil Incarnate
rulesText:
<Shift> 5 {I}

\Fools!\ You may put 5 character cards from your discard on the bottom of your deck in any order to shift this character for free.

\Raven's Call\ During your turn, whenever this character exerts, draw a card.
author: Erica D’urso

name: Tod & Copper
subtitle: Best of Friends
rulesText:
<Shift> 2 {I}

<Evasive>
author: Rob Di Salvo

name: Carl Fredricksen & Russell
subtitle: Intrepid Explorers
rulesText:
<Shift> 4 {I}

\Outdoor Skills\ While this character is at a location, all characters at that location get +1 {L} and gain <Evasive>.
author: Natalie Dombois

name: Mickey Mouse & Minnie Mouse
subtitle: Adventuring Duo
rulesText:
<Duo Shift> 0 {I}

\Thinking of You\ If this character would be banished, put them into your inkwell facedown and exerted instead.
author: Kenneth Anderson

name: Rapunzel & Flynn Rider
subtitle: Unlikely Pair
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I}

\Clever Swap\ Whenever this character quests, you may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.

\Fresh Start\ During your turn, whenever you discard a character card, you may play that character from your discard.
author: Jane Pica

name: Meilin Lee
subtitle: Popular Red Panda
rulesText:
<Temporary Shift> 3 {I}

\Karaoke Queen\ Once during your turn, whenever this character sings a song, gain 3 lore.
author: Eric Tan

name: Dash Parr & Violet Parr
subtitle: Super Siblings
rulesText:
<Combo Shift> 6 {I}

<Evasive>, <Resist> +1
\Incredible Tactics\ Whenever this character quests or challenges, draw a card for each card under them.
author: Rob Di Salvo

name: Darkwing Duck & Launchpad
subtitle: St. Canard's Finest
rulesText:
<Shift> 5 {I}

<Ward>

\Victory Pose\ During your turn, whenever this character banishes another character in a challenge, gain 2 lore.
author: Lyle Cruse

name: Scar
subtitle: Created by the Vine
rulesText:
\Victor's Reward\ During your turn, whenever one of your Floodborn characters banishes another character in a challenge, gain 1 lore.

\Fill the Ranks\ During an opponent's turn, whenever one of your Floodborn characters is banished, draw a card.
author: Tom Whalen

name: Lilo & Stitch
subtitle: Fun-Loving Friends
rulesText:
<Shift> 3 {I}

<Resist> +1 

<Support>
author: Brett Owens

name: Belle & Beast
subtitle: Certain as the Sun
rulesText:
<Shift> 6 {I}

\Inspiring Dance\ Whenever this character quests, ready all cards in your inkwell.

\Appreciative Audience\ 6 {I} — Ready your other characters. They can't quest for the rest of this turn.
author: Milica Celikovic

name: Pocahontas
subtitle: Guiding the Tribe
rulesText: \Stay Close\ When you play this character, you may play a character with cost 1 for free.
flavorText: “These vines are far from natural. They must end somewhere."
author: Kendall Hale

name: Vixey
subtitle: Expert Fisher
rulesText: \Stealing In\ When you play this character, if you have a character with <Evasive> in play, you may return chosen character, item, or location with cost 2 or less to their player's hand.
flavorText: "I've got my dinner. Where's yours, Tod?"
author: Oggy Christiansson

name: Buzz Lightyear
subtitle: Providing Cover
rulesText:
\Action Figure\ When you play this character, choose one of the following. If you have another Toy character in play, choose both instead:
• You may return an action card with cost 2 or less from your discard to your hand.
• You may play an action with cost 2 or less for free.
author: Marcel Berg

name: Boo
subtitle: Energetic Child
rulesText:
<Rush> (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)

\Kid-Tastrophe!\ Whenever this character challenges another character with 3 {S} or less, banish that character. (No damage is dealt in that challenge.)
author: Malia Ewart

name: Merlin
subtitle: Envisioning the Future
rulesText:
\Minor Trickery\ When you play this character, you may draw a card from the bottom of your deck.

\Age of Inconvenience\ When this character is banished, put this card from your discard on the bottom of your deck.
author: Carmine Pucci

name: Maximus
subtitle: Relentless Stallion
rulesText: \No Escape\ If you discarded a card this turn, this character gains <Challenger> +2 and can challenge ready characters this turn. (They get +2 {S} while challenging.)
author: Therese Vildefall

name: Morph
subtitle: Little Imitator
rulesText: \Advanced Mimicry\ You can shift any character on top of this character. (This includes all Shift variants.)
flavorText:
"Listen up. I've got a <special> job for you."
—John Silver
author: Brian Weisz

name: Meilin Lee
subtitle: Lead Vocalist
rulesText:
<Singer> 3 (This character counts as cost 3 to sing songs.)

\Band Loyalty\ This character can't sing songs without <Sing Together>.
author: Denny Minonne

name: Randall Boggs
subtitle: Scary Smart
rulesText:
\Get Outta Here!\ When you play this character, put chosen character of yours into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

\Devious Plan\ At the end of your turn, if all cards in your inkwell are exerted, gain 1 lore.
author: Kendall Hale

name: Rapunzel
subtitle: Escaping the Tower
rulesText: \The Call of Adventure\ Once during your turn, you may discard a card to give this character +1 {L} and <Evasive> until the start of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
author: Emily Abeydeera

name: Rapunzel
subtitle: Escaping the Tower
rulesText: \The Call of Adventure\ Once during your turn, you may discard a card to give this character +1 {L} and <Evasive> until the start of your next turn. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
author: Emily Abeydeera
